sentences.text: Bench: Joymalya Bagchi 04.10.2024 tkm/ct 6 C.R.R. 3580 of 2024 sl no.10

In Re : An application under section 482 Cr.P.C (presently section 528 of  the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023)
 And  In Re : Kishor Kumar Handal ....... petitione  Mr. Arindam Jana  Mr. Sumanta Ganguly  Mr. Partha Pratim Sinha  ...... for the petitioner  1.
Petitioner submits opposite party no. 2 has taken contradictory stance in regard to marital relationship between the parties.
On 6th September 2023 she filed an application under section 125 Cr.P.C claiming herself to be lawfully married to the petitioner.
Couple of days later impugned criminal was instituted alleging petitioner had cohabited on the false promise of marriage.
Thereafter, proceeding under section 125 Cr.P.C was withdrawn.

2. In light of the aforesaid submission which divulges inconsistent stance taken by opposite party no. 2 with regard to her marriage with petitioner, I am of the opinion petitioner has made out an arguable case for quashing of the proceeding.

3. Copy of the petition be served upon the opposite party no. 1/State through learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta and upon opposite party no. 2 through registered speed post with acknowledgement due and affidavit of service be filed on the next date of hearing.
4. Let the mater appear under the heading 'Contested Application' four weeks after Puja vacation.
5.

There shall be stay of operation of the proceeding being GR case no. 6 of 2024 arising out of Dantan PS case no. 3 of 2024 dated 6.1.2024 under section 417/376 IPC pending before the ACJM Dantan, Paschim Medinipur for a period of six weeks after puja vacation or until further orders,
whichever is earlier.
